an8.49:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Pubbārāme Migāramātupāsāde.
an8.49:1.2: Atha kho Visākhā Migāramātā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā . . . pe . . .
an8.49:1.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Visākhaṃ Migāramātaraṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:-- 2.
an8.49:2.1: Catūhi kho Visākhe dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo idhalokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, ayaṃsa loko āraddho hoti.
an8.49:2.3: Idha Visākhe mātugāmo susaṃvihitakammanto hoti saṅgahitaparijjano, bhattu manāpaṃ carati, sambhataṃ anurakkhati.
an8.49:3.1: Kathañ ca Visākhe mātugāmo susaṃvihitakammanto hoti? 4.
an8.49:3.2: Idha Visākhe mātugāmo ye te bhattu abbhantarā kammantā ‘uṇṇā' ti vā ‘kappāsā' ti vā, tattha dakkhā hoti analasā tatrupāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgatā alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.
an8.49:3.3: Evaṃ kho Visākhe mātugāmo susaṃvihitakammanto hoti.
an8.49:4.1: Kathañ ca Visākhe mātugāmo saṅgahitaparijjano hoti? 5.
an8.49:4.2: Idha Visākhe mātugāmo yo so bhattu abbhantaro antojano ‘dāsā' ti vā ‘pessā' ti vā ‘kammakarā' ti vā,
an8.49:4.3: tesaṃ katañ ca katato jānāti akatañ ca akatato jānāti gilānakānañ ca balābalaṃ jānāti, khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyañ c' assa paccaṃsena saṃvibhajati.
an8.49:4.4: Evaṃ kho Visākhe mātugāmo saṅgahitaparijjano hoti.
an8.49:5.1: Kathañ ca Visākhe mātugāmo bhattu manāpaṃ carati? 6.
an8.49:5.2: Idha Visākhe mātugāmo yaṃ bhattu amanāpasaṃkhātaṃ, taṃ jīvitahetu pi na ajjhācarati.
an8.49:5.3: Evaṃ kho Visākhe mātugāmo bhattu manāpaṃ carati.
an8.49:6.1: Kathañ ca Visākhe mātugāmo sambhataṃ anurakkhati? 7.
an8.49:6.2: Idha Visākhe mātugāmo yaṃ bhattā āharati dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā, taṃ ārakkhena guttiyā sampādeti, tattha ca hoti adhuttī athenī asoṇḍī avināsikā.
an8.49:6.3: Evaṃ kho Visākhe mātugāmo sambhataṃ anurakkhati.
an8.49:6.4: Imehi kho Visākhe catūhi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo idhalokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, ayaṃsa loko āraddho hoti. 8.
an8.49:7.1: Catūhi kho Visākhe dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo dhalokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, parassa loko āraddho hoti.
an8.49:7.3: Idha Visākhe mātugāmo saddhāsampanno hoti, sīlasampanno hoti, cāgasampanno hoti, paññāsampanno hoti.
an8.49:8.1: Kathañ ca Visākhe mātugāmo saddhāsampanno hoti? 10.
an8.49:8.2: Idha Visākhe mātugāmo saddho hoti, saddahati Tathāgatassa bodhiṃ
an8.49:8.3: ‘iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi Satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho Bhagavā' ti.
an8.49:8.4: Evaṃ kho Visākhe mātugāmo saddhāsampanno hoti.
an8.49:9.1: Kathañ ca Visākhe mātugāmo sīlasampanno hoti? 11.
an8.49:9.2: Idha Visākhe mātugāmo pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti . . . pe . . . surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti.
an8.49:9.3: Evaṃ kho Visākhe mātugāmo sīlasampanno hoti.
an8.49:10.1: Kathañ ca Visākhe mātugāmo cāgasampanno hoti? 12.
an8.49:10.2: Idha Visakhe mātugāmo vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgā payatapāṇī vossaggaratā yācayogā dānasaṃvibhāgaratā.
an8.49:10.3: Evaṃ kho Visākhe mātugāmo cāgasampanno hoti.
an8.49:11.1: Kathañ ca Visākhe mātugāmo paññāsampanno hoti? 13.
an8.49:11.2: Idha Visākhe mātugāmo paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
an8.49:11.3: Evaṃ kho Visākhe mātugāmo paññāsampanno hoti.
an8.49:12.1: Imehi kho Visākhe catūhi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo paralokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, parassa loko āraddho hotī ti.
